verdict.rationale: n8n supports error handling via error workflows (n8n-docs-5) and community evidence confirms users configure retries for sporadic failures in production (n8n-comm-18), but the evidence pack does not document a specific 'retry with backoff' configuration option, backoff intervals, or exponential backoff settings. Missing for 10: explicit docs on per-node retry/backoff configuration options, evidence of configurable wait times or exponential backoff, and independent hands-on confirmation of backoff behavior beyond a single anecdotal mention.
